A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same DirectFisheye-GS study and complete 16-page material, including supplementary Sections A-G. Text extraction and page-by-page rendering comparisons establish that all scientific content is unchanged.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction experiments, CVO ablations, toy experiments, batch-size analyses, and computational measurements in Sections 4-5 and the supplementary material.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark evaluations and ablations in Tables 1-11 and supplementary toy experiments in Figures 7-8.

M1.justification: The Kannala-Brandt fisheye formulation, cross-view joint optimization, losses, and rendering/backpropagation procedures are identical in Section 3 and Algorithms 1-3.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same FisheyeNeRF, ScanNet++, Den-SOFT, and Tanks & Temples coverage, with identical fisheye, pinhole, boundary-region, and synthetic toy scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including the 3DGS variants, Fisheye-GS, 3DGUT, Self-Cali-GS, and random-view-selection controls.

E3.justification: The same scene selections, image resolutions, preprocessing, training/test-view evaluations, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS metrics, batch sizes, and training budgets are reported in Section 4 and the supplementary experiments.

E4.justification: Both retain identical CVO and view-selection ablations, boundary-region comparisons, Gaussian-scale analyses, synthetic toy experiments, and batch-size sensitivity analyses, including supplementary Figures 7-10 and Table 10.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is identical. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests; the Gaussian-scale distributions in Figure 6 are also unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-11 and qualitative results in the figures are unchanged, including supplementary test-view scores, batch-size results, training times, and rendering speeds.

T1.justification: Equations 1-7 and the supplementary covariance-gradient and distortion analysis are identical. No mathematical definitions, derivations, assumptions, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, conclusion, and supplementary contribution statements retain the same claims about native fisheye input, cross-view consistency, pinhole applicability, and competitive reconstruction performance.

C2.justification: The explanations of distortion-induced anisotropy and baseline behavior are unchanged. Supplementary Section G retains the same limitations concerning complex lighting, reflectance modeling, and challenging reconstruction regions.

D1.justification: COLMAP processing, NVIDIA A100 80GB hardware, batch size 2, implementation descriptions, and supplementary pseudocode are unchanged. No code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The references and research positioning in Section 2 and supplementary Section B are identical, including comparisons with prior fisheye modeling and multi-view optimization work.

P1.justification: The Acknowledgment on PDF page 9 changes NSFC grant number 62171255 to 62422110. The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v1, 1 Apr 2026, to v2, 26 May 2026. All other wording and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-10, Tables 1-11, captions, formatting, and placement are identical. Rendering differences are confined to the updated arXiv stamp and acknowledgment digits, with no restructuring of the layout.

improvement.justification: v2 changes one funding grant number and the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and appendices, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
